application_sentences: Energy Efficiency: Designed for power savings, the chambers use a wide-range refrigeration control system and patented cross-output control.
Applications: Suitable for various environmental testing applications, providing reliable performance and precise control.

Downloads Description: The Espec E-series temperature and climate chambers are mainly used for conducting temperature and climate tests on large and often heavy products, or if many small products need to be tested at the same time.
Espec Walk-in Climate Chambers The high-quality Espec walk-in (temperature and) climate chambers from the new E-series are suitable for carrying out a wide range of international tests.

High-Power Series Conforms to global automobile test standards These products conform to the ISO 16750 international standard that is widely used for global procurement of vehicle devices and components, and also to the LV124 standard created by European automobile manufacturers.
